Subject: Continuous assurance subscription — SOW addendum request

Hi Ana / Jordan,

Quick note to start a thread on an operational change we'd like to make to the upcoming annual testing engagement. Instead of a single red team event this fall, Security would like to move to a 12-month "continuous assurance" subscription: quarterly red team exercises, monthly targeted application scans (SAST/DAST), and two purple-team knowledge-transfer sessions.

Could you: 1) confirm whether you can package that as a subscription amendment to our current SOW (attached: SOW_current_v3.pdf), 2) provide a ballpark all-in price for the 12-month cadence, and 3) outline access windows/credential requirements for staging vs. prod? We need an executable proposal for procurement/legal by end of next week.

Constraints:
- All active testing must be performed in staging environments only; we cannot provide persistent production credentials.
- Any exploit artifacts must be submitted to our evidence bucket and deleted within 72 hours unless explicitly retained for remediation tracking.
- We want at least one purple-team in-person/remote workshop near the mid-point.

Cc'ing Dev, Security Ops, and Procurement (Marissa) to weigh in.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_current_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the details — we can absolutely support a subscription-style engagement. Quick answers up front:
1) We can draft an SOW addendum that converts the one-off engagement into a 12-month subscription with quarterly red teams, monthly scans (SAST/DAST), and two purple team workshops.
2) Ballpark pricing (subject to final scope): $180k–$220k for the year depending on scan volume and on-site workshop travel. We'll send a formal pricing sheet.
3) Access: staging-level service accounts (non-prod) and timeboxed ephemeral credentials are preferred. For credentialed scanning we ask for a 48-hour window per monthly scan and a separate 5-day window for the red team exercises. No persistent admin credentials.

I'll attach our pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx and a short addendum outline. Before we finalize the doc, a couple of clarifying questions: do you want the monthly SAST to include both CI-gated runs and full-service scans, and should we include scope for container image scans?

Best,
Ana Santos
Account Director, GreyMatter Security
ana.santos@greymattersec.com
Attachment: pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Kimberly / Ana — quick tech detail from infra:

We can provide ephemeral staging credentials via our vault with 48-hour leases; that works for the monthly scans. For the quarterly red team windows we'll provision isolated test tenants in a separate project (no production traffic).

Answers to Ana's questions:
- Monthly SAST: we want both CI-gated quick runs and one full-service scan per month against the staging branch; the CI gating should be limited to PR-level checks (fast), while the full scan can be scheduled off-hours.
- Container image scans: yes, include image scanning for our main service images (approx 18 images) as part of the monthly cadence.

If you need sample CI configs or image lists, I can drop them into the procurement ticket.

— Dev
